Banking Consultant, Bentleigh VIC

About Us

At Example Bank we help people and communities thrive with everyday banking.

As a Banking Consultant you will serve customers in branch, open accounts and answer questions about everyday products.

What you will do

  • Greet and serve customers face to face
  • Process deposits and withdrawals accurately
  • Refer customers to specialists

Eligibility

You must hold Australian citizenship or permanent residency to apply for this role.
